hooks.command: f=$(sed -n "s/.*\"file_path\"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*\"\([^\"]*\)\".*/\1/p" | head -1); case "$f" in *Bot.java) ;; *) exit 0;; esac; m=$(powershell -NoProfile -File tools/check-bot-docs.ps1) || printf "{\"decision\":\"block\",\"reason\":\"docs/bot-commands.md documents every //bot command except: %s. Add it to the table there before going on.\"}\n" "$(echo $m | tr "\n" " ")"
